title: SKE Crystal Blueberry Raspberries Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Raspberries flavour SKE Crystal Nic Salts e-liquid combines the sweet, slightly tart taste of fresh Blueberries with the vibrant, refreshing tang of Raspberries for a delightfully fruity vape. This flavour is part of SKE's renowned Crystal Nic Salts collection, which has been enhanced with new packaging, new flavours, and an improved formula that brings out the richness of the classic berry duo. The unique properties of nicotine salts allow this e-liquid to deliver a smoother throat hit, even at higher nicotine strengths, making it an ideal choice for those transitioning from smoking to vaping. With a 50VG/50PG ratio, this e-liquid ensures a harmonious balance of flavour intensity and cloud production, suitable for a wide range of MTL devices. Whether you're a new vaper or a seasoned enthusiast looking for a dependable daily vape, Blueberry Raspberries flavour offers a satisfying experience with every puff. Try it and explore the other 24 flavours in the SKE Crystal Nic Salt range to discover your new favourite!
